text:
Ava: Quick leadership bulletin — two short items for all managers. Please read and ACK.
Ava: 1) Compliance guardrails for Private deployments go live Monday 2026-04-06. This enforces retention defaults + KMS enforcement for new clusters. No breaking schema changes; mainly config + policy. Docs: https://intra.redwood/company/policies/private-compliance (TL;DR in next msg) :eyes:
Diego: Noted. We'll need a tiny Console tweak for the retention toggle and an API flag for dedicated customers. Scheduling a 30m sync Wed to scope UI/SDK work.
Maya: I can own infra checklist and canary plan. Quick Q — do we require immediate agent-side key rotation when customers opt in?
Ava: Good Q — key rotation isn't mandatory during opt-in. Customers choosing KMS enforcement will be recommended to rotate within 7 days; ops will provide rotation playbooks.
Sam: Ops heads-up: canaries for private-beta customers overlap with Q2 capacity ramp. Recommend temporarily bumping two dedicated GPU pools for the first 48h of canary. I'll open a change ticket.
announce-bot: [Scheduled] Private-beta canary window: 2026-04-08 00:00 UTC — 2026-04-10 00:00 UTC. Trigger: rollout/canary/private-beta-2026-04-08
Diego: I'll draft the rollout checklist in Drive and tag product owners. Link: https://drive.redwood/rollouts/private-gatekeeper-2026 (edit: invite sent)
Lilli: People ops note: no hiring freeze. We are prioritizing infra, security, and SRE hires due to this rollout. I'll post updated req list to #people-ops and ping hiring managers.
Ava: Managers: cascade these three asks to teams by EOD Thursday: 1) review docs, 2) RSVP to Wed sync, 3) list any blockers in the rollout doc.
Diego: For the SDK change we expect a two-week sprint. Will include deprecation notes if needed.
Maya: Canary plan snippet:```
- stage 1: 5 customers, smoke tests, 6h
- stage 2: 20 customers, cost/latency checks, 24h
- stage 3: full canary cohort, 48h
logs: /var/logs/canary/private-2026-04
```
Sam: I'll attach autoscaling policy diff to the change ticket. Short command to extract current pools: `rdw infra list-pools --type dedicated --region eu-west`
Ava: Also starting an internal audit run next week — heads of eng & security to validate the KMS integrations.
Diego: pinging @Maya and @Sam for audit coord.
Maya: ack — we'll provide runbook and contact hours.
Sam: ack. I'll coordinate with oncall for the canary weekend.
Lilli: ack. I'll circulate manager communication templates and FAQ draft for customer-facing teams.
Ava: Thanks all. One leadership ask: highlight any tactical risks in a single bullet under the rollout doc by Friday so we can decide go/no-go early next week. :rocket:
